tei:div.tei:p: (93)kyai/ dkar phyogs skyong ba'i dgra lha che// rig 'dzin padma'i 'bangs gcig pu// lha srin dregs pa yongs kyi rje// dge bsnyen rdo rje ngang dkar

rtsal// yum chen ra 'ju rgyal mo dang*// sras mchog lha btsan rdo rje 'bar// mtshams kyi klu rgyal mi mgon dkar// seng chen g.yu rtse seng ngu dang*// ze ze ngang pa dkar yag lha// dge bsnyen nis ra ri nag gnyen// wa rgyal g.yu 'od 'bo yol dang*// ba thal yo ru lha yi rtse// ra sag snang sras lci na dang*// gla ba rkang gcig stag kha ral// rkang thang zhags 'dzin 'brang rgyas dang*// dam can 'dzang ri 'bum khe gnyan// dbu khri rdo rje lcags phur can// mu nu bya rgod mthon po dang*// g.yu sgon g.yang phug ku sha sman// mo sman mched brgyad mtsho sman dang*// ldang sman mched bdun bzhin bzang sogs// gnyug mar gnas dang glo bur lhags// lha klu bdud btsan dmu sman sogs// mthu chen srung ma'i dmag tshogs rnams// 'dir gshegs bsang gi mchod pa bzhes// gsol lo mchod do mnga' gsol lo// dbu 'phang gnyen po dgung du bstod// rtag tu srung skyob ma g.yel bar// bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod// ces pa'ang rang la nyer mkho'i phyir (95)du dam pa snga ma'i gsung las btus pa'ang padma nor bus so/// /
